title: Proxy application marker borrowed views
mode: source-demonstrated copy avoidance with generated local controls
scope: Borrow group-102 marker text during raw-DXF nesting validation
Avoid intermediate marker and substring copies while capturing proxy application-group names
Preserve proxy record scoping and nested application-group behavior

implementation.summary: updateRawDxfApplicationDepth() and collectProxyDxfGroup() now inspect group-102 strings through std::string_view. ProxyCapture retains its required owning group-name string by emplacing the marker's pointer/length range directly, avoiding the former temporary marker string plus substr temporary. Added a focused selector for the existing proxy marker-inside-application-group control.

assessment.claim: The selected raw-DXF/proxy application-marker paths avoid intermediate owned marker/substr strings. ProxyCapture still owns one copy of each active group name because it uses that name after the immediate marker inspection. This is not an allocator-count, peak-RSS, or throughput measurement.
assessment.coverage: Existing generated controls validate that group-100 markers inside group-102 application data do not re-arm proxy payload parsing; the owning hardening CTest covers the broader proxy and retained-payload controls.
assessment.limitations: No full suite, external drawing, peer parser, CAD application, or persistent fixture was used.
